candidates.title: Interactive Pet Personality & Style Choice Grid
candidates.change: Redesign pet selection into a interactive split cards view with explicit style tags to prevent unexpected pet generation outputs.
candidates.why: Adoption conversion is low at 60.9% with long wait times, and 3 support emails reported custom pets looking wrong or failing.

pick_friend.headline: Choose Your Companion's Base Style
pick_friend.body: Select a personality template and baseline look for your desktop pet before final adoption.

guard.reason: Redesigns the pet selection layout while preserving the ability to choose a pet.

candidates.score_note: Adoption step has high dropoff (39.1%) and support emails; UI redesign targets styling expectations.

candidates.title: Desktop Pet Controls Quick-Reference Screen
candidates.change: Insert a new screen before completion showing key shortcuts and tray icon controls for interacting with, hiding, and talking to the pet.
candidates.why: 3 support tickets noted confusion on how to control, hide, or talk to the pet after onboarding completes.

new_controls_guide.headline: Mastering Your Desktop Pet Controls
new_controls_guide.body: Quick key combinations and system tray actions to interact with or hide your pet at any time.

guard.reason: Adds a new controls guide screen inside onboarding, which is permitted by rule 4.

candidates.score_note: Finish step drops significantly (35.2%) with user confusion, but adding a new screen requires release cost 0.

candidates.title: Desktop Display Health Verification Hint
candidates.change: Display an active render status hint and graphics driver check on the waiting screen so users know their screen settings are compatible.
candidates.why: 3 support emails mentioned the pet failing to show up on the desktop or the app stalling at home load.

waiting.hint: Checking desktop overlay permissions and graphics renderer status...

guard.reason: Adds display status information to the waiting screen without removing its core functionality.

candidates.score_note: Home step retains 84.8% of users, though status hint addresses 3 support tickets about rendering.

candidates.title: Account Conflict & Duplicate Prevention Card
candidates.change: Switch the sign-in step to a split layout highlighting an account switch warning to avoid accidental duplicate account creation.
candidates.why: 8 support emails complained about pets missing or reset after signing in with a secondary account.

sign_in.headline: Sign In to Keep Your Existing Pets
sign_in.body: Use your primary account email to ensure all previously adopted companions sync automatically.
sign_in.hint: Already adopted a pet? Sign in with the exact same account to preserve your save file.

components.text: Signing in with a new social account will start a fresh inventory.

guard.reason: text in 'sign_in.body' asks for or mentions personal data

candidates.title: Photo Framing & Quality Validation Flow
candidates.change: Add an explicit photo validation sub-flow screen that confirms image clarity and face detection prior to generation.
candidates.why: Custom pet generation fails or yields bad visual results for several users during adoption.

new_photo_validator.headline: Validating Photo Clarity
new_photo_validator.body: We are scanning your photos to ensure optimal 3D pet rendering quality.

guard.reason: Inserts a photo validation screen into onboarding without skipping required steps.

candidates.score_note: Targets adoption dropoff with validation flow, though introducing a new flow screen carries higher build cost.

candidates.title: Path Selection Time Expectation Copy
candidates.change: Update the header and hint copy on choose_path to explain what each adoption path entails and how fast setup takes.
candidates.why: The choose_path step has a median time of 8s but a mean time of 514s, indicating significant user idling and hesitation.

choose_path.headline: Pick Your Creation Path (Takes 1 Minute)
choose_path.body: Choose between instant adoption from our species library or custom AI photo generation.
choose_path.hint: Instant adoption lets you start playing right away; photo creation takes 30s longer.

guard.reason: Updates path selection copy while maintaining options for both adopting and creating a pet.

candidates.score_note: Copy change is config-only (cost 2) targeting high mean time on choose_path, though evidence relies mostly on time disparity.

candidates.title: Interactive Generation Wait Carousel
candidates.change: Add an interactive tip carousel and animated progress badge on the waiting screen while pet assets render.
candidates.why: The waiting stage home conversion drops and has a high mean time of 2336s with users unsure if generation hung.

wait_status.text: Tip: Right-click your desktop pet anytime to change its size or mood.

guard.reason: replacement for 'waiting.wait_status' does not do the job: needs 1 of ['preview', 'progress', 'timer']

candidates.title: System Tray & Desktop Pet Welcome Redesign
candidates.change: Redesign home_intro into a full-bleed spotlight screen emphasizing how the pet lives on the desktop toolbar.
candidates.why: Users finish onboarding (84.8% home -> 64.8% finish drop) and email support asking how to access their pet on desktop.

home_intro.headline: Your Pet is Live on Your Desktop!
home_intro.body: Look for your companion roaming your screen and find controls in your system tray icon.

guard.reason: Redesigns home_intro within onboarding boundaries while preserving its welcome job.

candidates.score_note: Redesigns finishing experience to reduce 35.2% dropoff at finish backed by support emails.

candidates.title: Sign-In Status Safeguard & Offline Fallback
candidates.change: Add a connection status check and retry notification on the sign_in screen.
candidates.why: 2 support emails reported the sign-in screen stalling or failing to load properly.

guard.reason: Adds authentication server status indicators to the sign-in screen.

candidates.score_note: Addresses sign_in edge cases mentioned in 2 support emails with moderate conversion impact.

candidates.title: Certificate Confirmation Sequence Reorder
candidates.change: Reorder adoption_certificate to appear directly after waiting asset creation so users confirm the naming after seeing the generated render.
candidates.why: Adoption completion rate is lowest in the funnel (60.9%), and confirming pet name before seeing final render causes confusion.

adoption_certificate.headline: Official Adoption Certificate
adoption_certificate.body: Name your freshly created desktop pet and make it official!

guard.reason: existing screens must keep their order; only sign_in may move
